rationale: Separate printed-shell assembly clearance from carbon-spar adhesive bondline instead of uniformly shrinking the rib. Preserve dedicated spar contact area while reducing sensitivity to FDM dimensional variation at the skin.
verification_required: verify no skin or spar interference
verify 0.10 mm minimum dedicated spar bondline
print P2S material-specific fit coupon before freezing tolerance
select adhesive system and verify bondline
verify structural load transfer before print or flight release
